component.name: Kumo
component.summary: Free VPN client powered by sing-box and Xray

description.p: Kumo connects to the servers and subscriptions you choose. It can run as a local proxy (also set as the system proxy) or tunnel the whole computer, and it supports many protocols, subscriptions, routing rules, ad blocking and more.
In this package the tunnel cannot be opened (the sandbox does not allow it): Kumo works as a local proxy.
